fusions.name: Slow Reckoning
fusions.desc: A slow, heavy overhand blow for 16 damage that stuns the target for 1.2 seconds, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.2 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Lazy Swipe
fusions.desc: Swings an arm round lazily, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stripping 15% of their movement speed and 5% of their armour for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbothered Bulk
fusions.desc: Settles your weight and stops caring: your armour rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Outlasted
fusions.desc: When a condition on you runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
